description.value: Pür & Simple is a Canadian breakfast and brunch franchise chain with over 65 locations across the country, serving modern twists on comfort-food classics in a bright, upscale setting. The Port Coquitlam outpost sits within Fremont Village, a busy retail hub, and offers a full sit-down menu spanning eggs, waffles, crepes, benedicts, smoothies, and a dedicated coffee bar. The menu includes clearly labelled vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-sensitive items, making it a flexible refuelling stop for cyclists with varied dietary needs.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (1 space) at 53m; stands (1 space) at 55m. Total: 2 spaces.

The website's Alberta menu page shows explicit vegan (Vg), vegetarian (V), and gluten-sensitive categories, and the 'Order Online' button sitewide confirms takeout ordering.
